title: fstream is no longer supported
summary: npm states that the fstream package is no longer supported.

constraints: Preserve filesystem traversal, filtering, permissions, ownership, symlink handling, stream backpressure, and archive boundary security.

steps.title: Replace filesystem streaming
steps.instructions: Select maintained filesystem and archive primitives for the used fstream behavior, migrate readers and writers, then remove fstream.

verification.purpose: Run files, directories, symlinks, permissions, errors, and repository tests.
